name: Futures Positioning / Open-Interest Intelligence — Pairwise Direction Engine
hypothesis: Historical open-interest and trader-positioning/crowding state can improve the pairwise LONG-versus-SHORT decision and identify the strongest directional opportunities more effectively than the failed absolute candidate scorers.
priorOutcomeBoundary: MIE1 price/microstructure outcomes through 2026-05-01 are contaminated and may not be used for symbol filtering or threshold rescue. MIE2 uses a new positioning data family and a prelocked pairwise target. May-2026 onward remains unopened.

transitionQuarantine.reason: Binance USD-M metrics archive create_time convention changed on 2026-06-25; transition days are excluded from formal validation/holdout scoring.

knownArchiveNormalization.before20260625: create_time is treated as end-of-period availability time.
knownArchiveNormalization.from20260625: create_time is shifted +5 minutes before causal use because archive labels changed to start-of-period while content represents the following 5-minute interval.
knownArchiveNormalization.transitionDuplicateRule: After normalization, exact duplicate availability timestamps must agree numerically or the symbol/day is fail-closed; the 2026-06-25 transition window is excluded from formal validation/holdout.

inheritedExecutionAuthority.rule: Use exactly the MIE1 frozen 1h execution simulation: next-open entry, 1ATR stop, 1.5R TP2 full exit, 24h max hold, stop-first same-bar, base/stress costs and realized funding. No execution-rule change is permitted inside MIE2.

pairwiseDecisionUnit.unit: one symbol at one completed 1h decision time
pairwiseDecisionUnit.outcomes: simulate both LONG and SHORT using the inherited frozen execution plan before constructing pairwise targets
pairwiseDecisionUnit.longBetter: 1 if targetSpreadR > 0, otherwise 0; exact ties are discarded from model fitting but retained in baseline diagnostics.
pairwiseDecisionUnit.bestGoodOpportunity: 1 if either direction reaches the frozen +1.5R TP2 before stop within 24h.
pairwiseDecisionUnit.chosenDirectionOpportunity: For evaluation only: whether the model-selected direction reaches TP2 before stop.

model.preprocessing: MedianImputer + StandardScaler numeric; OneHotEncoder symbolGroup; all fitted on MIE2 fit only.

scoring.semantics: All model outputs are research ranking scores; no calibrated probability claim.

selection.perDecisionTimestamp: Rank the 12 symbol decisions by strength descending; deterministic tie-break symbol ascending. Select exactly top 2 symbols and execute each model-chosen direction.

developmentMetrics.pairDirectionAccuracy: Fraction of selected symbol-hours where chosen direction realized netR >= opposite direction realized netR.
developmentMetrics.opportunityRecall: Selected chosen-direction goodOpportunity count / all eligible directional goodOpportunity count.
developmentMetrics.opportunityPrecision: Selected chosen-direction goodOpportunity count / selected trades.
developmentMetrics.baseline: At the same selected symbol-hours, compare chosen-direction netR to the 50/50 LONG/SHORT pair mean; also compare portfolio expectancy to all symbol-hour pair means.

bootstrap.method: hierarchical symbol circular 24-hour decision blocks with frozen selections

antiOverfit: No feature addition/removal after development outcomes.
No use of MIE1 winners/losers to filter MIE2.
No opening fresh validation or holdout unless every MIE2 development gate passes.
No R15 mutation before independent live-provider parity, fresh validation, sealed holdout and final Senior Council gate.
terminalRule: MIE2 is the final positioning/OHLC-derived research family in this closure campaign. If MIE2 fails development, do not launch another derived-price/positioning model inside this project. Close alpha research as not proven and keep R15 frozen. Only a future separately authorized project with materially different data such as historical order-book depth/liquidations may restart research.
nextAuthorizedAction: Freeze checksum-verified Binance USD-M daily metrics only through 2026-04-30, aggregate causally to hourly positioning snapshots, and do not touch 2026-05-01 onward unless development passes.
